title: Non-descriptive test name: validate_message_id_tests
description: In crates/core/src/validation.rs, the test function 'validate_message_id_tests' (line 533) is a table-driven test covering multiple invalid and valid Message-ID forms. The name does not communicate what properties are under test. In a test failure, the output will say 'validate_message_id_tests FAILED' with no indication of which case triggered it (since they are inline asserts, not subtests). A more descriptive name like 'validate_message_id_rejects_malformed_and_accepts_valid' or splitting into separate tests with names like 'missing_angle_brackets', 'missing_at_sign', 'exceeds_length_limit' would make the test suite self-documenting and make failures easier to locate.
